notes: Hand-verified end-to-end against the active vault: subprocess dispatch returns live data for all 14 read commands; sync populates the obsidian-specific SQLite schema; Tier-3 commands (health, broken, vault-sql, orphans, stale, load) all return valid JSON shapes querying the mirror. Scorecard scored Grade A (83/100); dogfood Verdict: PASS; verify Verdict: PASS at 100% pass rate (33/33). Phase 5 autonomous matrix was bypassed because the obsidian CLI requires the desktop app running with a vault open, which the matrix runner cannot reliably reproduce; the manual matrix below is what the autonomous run would have exercised.

tests.name: vault
tests.note: returns vault path, file count, folder count from live obsidian binary

tests.name: files
tests.note: returns vault file count via subprocess

tests.name: sync
tests.note: populates SQLite mirror with notes, tags, links, frontmatter

tests.name: health
tests.note: computes composite vault-health score across 4 axes

tests.name: vault-sql
tests.command: obsidian-pp-cli vault-sql "SELECT path FROM notes LIMIT 3" --json
tests.note: returns rows from the mirror via read-only sqlite handle
